scope: Local changes and synthetic validation; production observations in the initial audit are historical.

benchmarks.limitations: Small local synthetic workloads; no production traffic, soak, multi-replica or ATS capacity certification.

blockers: Certify completeness contracts and monitor unknown coverage across active sources.
Rehearse coordinated migration and recovery on a representative isolated copy; verify production backups and RPO/RTO.
Prove alert delivery and independent scheduler/monitoring failure detection.
Harmonize purge, retireSource, separation and event retention with concurrency invariants.
Make CSV activation follow the same dated evidence contract as promotion.
Validate deployment isolation, least privilege, dependency exposure and sustained load.
Measure storage growth and define retention for observations, search projection, index, WAL and backups.
remainingQualityWork: Full source health dimensions and history
Independent worldwide employer reference coverage and annotated quality evaluation
